lines: I gather the fragments of passing time
I write in the margins of my notebook as time simply passes
"When will the answer come?"
Toward a faint, tiny emotion,
I offer a single love, goodbye, goodbye
Until it lights up with the warmth blooming in the night
With a single breath, I live, I live
So that I do not weep beside those gentle days, oh
So that I do not weep
Tiny words stung me
Though there is no end to it
I am tired of pretending to have forgotten
Oh night, hold me close
Even today, I smile, I smile
I smile to hide the me who is about to cry
It is fine to leave the unspeakable unsaid
If I could believe that, would my heart feel lighter?
I offer a single love, goodbye, goodbye
Until it lights up with the warmth blooming in the night
With a single breath, I live, I live
So that I do not weep beside those gentle days
I offer a single love, goodbye, goodbye, oh
I offer a single love, goodbye, goodbye
So that I may smile beside those gentle days, oh
Letting out my feelings is easy,
But the difficulty of living is far too high
It is full of questions I can never solve, oh
Looking straight ahead with perfect clarity—
You do not have to do that, so just hold me close
I offer a single love, goodbye, goodbye
